items.title: Use Amazon ECR global authentication token across AWS Regions
items.summary: Amazon ECR now supports global authentication tokens: request one token from AWS Sign-In and use it to push and pull images across AWS Regions in the same partition, with a lifetime from 5 minutes to 12 hours. This post shows how to request a global token and use it with Docker in two Regions.
items.creator: Sourav Kundu
